title: BEST APP EVER🥳🥳🥳
body: THIS APP IS SO GOOD!!!!!!! I have ADHD and struggle with resting for the night, keeping on top of tasks, and social situations. This app has let me keep track of how I am feeling and why so I can recognise why I might be feeling that way. It has also made meditations(which I normally hate) personal for me, whatever issue I have I can write it down and how I need a bit of help (never gonna pick breathing) and the AI talks through ur and how a big deep breath can be used to calm and freshen how we are feeling. Most apps half as good as this one are all about money and have $100 charges just to use the features. This all however, it is different no charges at all, the best this I have ever heard of. I recommend this app to young ADHD’ers who are struggling to make sense or push through some emotion (or physical) issues in their life. Good luck to people on their journey I hope you find this app as amazing as I do.

title: Great App
body: It is a fantastic app designed to support individuals with ADHD, offering various tools and resources to help manage symptoms and improve focus. The interface is intuitive and user-friendly, making it easy to navigate through the different features. However, there is a notable issue with the audio playback: when the phone screen turns off, the audio stops playing. This can be particularly disruptive during activities such as meditation, where continuous audio is crucial. Addressing this issue would significantly enhance the user experience. Despite this drawback, Univi remains a valuable app for ADHD support.
author: fivxdtjjxsikb

title: Truly Impressive: This App Surpassed All My Expectations!
body:
The Univi ADHD managing app is an exceptional tool, even for those not diagnosed with ADHD. It helps users organise their days effectively and achieve a healthy work-life balance. With its unique approach of rewarding personal achievements, Univi fosters motivation and self-discipline.
Drawing on principles reminiscent of Jordan Peterson's motivational talks, the app promotes a sense of well-being and personal responsibility. Whether you aim to improve your daily routines or enhance your productivity, Univi provides valuable strategies to help you thrive in both work and life. I highly recommend it!

title: A Disappointment
body: A lot of apps today are intentionally designed to trick people into paying for subscriptions. They push free trials that automatically convert, hide the real cost in tiny text, rush users through the screen, and don’t give a fair chance to review the purchase before charging. That’s not innovation—it’s manipulation. When people feel forced or misled into paying, that’s a scam, plain and simple.

title: Not enough time to know if I like it or not
body:
This app seems different than others. It doesn’t “seem” like they are out for money and are trying to feed you a bunch of garbage. It really seems genuine. However, I am rating it 1 little star all because, like so many other apps, it only gives you 7 measly days to try the app out before you get charged for the month or the year. I mean come on! I have ADD, don’t really think I’ve used the app enough in 7 days to actually figure out it’s worthy to pay for it, or subscribe to it, or not? Heck 30 days probably isn’t enough time either but I could understand that better. 

So, like many other apps, I will delete it and cancel it today (before the 7 days are up) and will never know if it would’ve helped me or not. Which is too bad because like I said I feel like this app is different, in a good way. Oh well.
